property_summary: The reference C always returns true on a successful non-reverting transfer; the buggy version returns false on the same successful execution, violating the property that the return value must be true.
For any call to transfer that completes without reverting, the return value must be true; the buggy version returns false on exactly those successful calls, violating this rule.
For any call that does not revert, the return value of transfer must be true; the mutant always returns false, violating this rule.
